question: Which image-sacrifice is chief of all sacrifices, and how often in desired convention?
premises: this would be image-sacrifice, chief of all sacrifices
in the desired, but in convention, seven times to be done thus-like
inference: Image-rite outranks all rites; sevenfold performance in desired convention.
plain_english: This would be image-sacrifice, chief of all sacrifices — in the desired, but in convention, seven times to be done thus-like.
